Test Steps: Verify Admin can create new Allowance components
Test Data: 1. Log in as Admin 2. Go to Payroll Settings 3. Add Allowance 'Internet Allowance' (Flat 1000) 4. Save
Date of execution: Component should be created and available for assignment.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can create new Deduction components
Test Data: 1. Add Deduction 'PF' (Percentage 12% of Basic) 2. Save
Date of execution: Deduction component should be saved correctly.

Test Steps: Verify validation when percentage deduction exceeds 100%
Test Data: 1. Add Deduction 2. Set percentage to 110% 3. Save
Date of execution: System should throw error 'Percentage cannot exceed 100'.

Test Steps: Verify validation when fixed amount is negative
Test Data: 1. Add Allowance 2. Enter amount as -500 3. Save
Date of execution: System should reject negative amounts in component definition.

Test Steps: Verify assigning Salary Structure to an Active Employee
Test Data: 1. Go to Employees > Salary 2. Select Employee 3. Enter Basic: 50000 4. Add HRA, TA 5. Save
Date of execution: Salary structure should be mapped to the employee successfully.

Test Steps: Verify validation when assigning Salary to an Inactive/Terminated employee
Test Data: 1. Select Terminated Employee 2. Attempt to assign Salary
Date of execution: System should show error 'Cannot assign salary to inactive employee'.

Test Steps: Verify validation for Zero Base Salary
Test Data: 1. Enter Basic Pay as 0 2. Save
Date of execution: System should reject and prompt 'Basic Pay must be greater than zero'.

Test Steps: Verify Salary Calculation for a full month (No Absences)
Test Data: 1. Go to Run Payroll 2. Select Month (e.g. Past Month) 3. Select Employee (0 absences) 4. Calculate
Date of execution: Gross and Net pay should calculate accurately (Base + Allowances - Deductions).

Test Steps: Verify Salary Calculation with LWP (Loss of Pay)
Test Data: 1. Select Employee with 3 days Unpaid Leave/Absent 2. Calculate Payroll
Date of execution: System should deduct (Gross / Total Month Days) * 3 from salary.

Test Steps: Verify Overtime (OT) bonus inclusion in Salary
Test Data: 1. Select Employee with 10 hours Approved OT 2. Calculate Payroll
Date of execution: System should add OT Bonus based on configured hourly rate.

Test Steps: Verify TDS (Tax) calculation based on annual brackets
Test Data: 1. Calculate payroll for high-bracket salary employee
Date of execution: System should deduct TDS accurately as per configured tax slabs.

Test Steps: Verify PF calculation correctly applies on Basic Pay only
Test Data: 1. Check deduction details for PF
Date of execution: PF amount should be exactly 12% of Basic Pay (and not Gross).

Test Steps: Verify validation when running Payroll for a future month
Test Data: 1. Go to Run Payroll 2. Select next month 3. Calculate
Date of execution: System should block payroll execution for months that haven't ended.

Test Steps: Verify validation when running Payroll twice for the same employee in same month
Test Data: 1. Run payroll for Employee A for Jan 2. Attempt to run payroll again for Jan
Date of execution: System should show error 'Payroll already processed for this month'.

Test Steps: Verify bulk processing of Payroll for entire department
Test Data: 1. Filter by 'IT Dept' 2. Select all employees 3. Click 'Run Payroll'
Date of execution: System should batch-process and generate drafts for all selected employees.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can review and Approve generated Draft Payrolls
Test Data: 1. Go to Payroll Approvals 2. Select a Draft Payroll 3. Click 'Approve'
Date of execution: Status changes to 'Approved'.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can reject or Recalculate a Draft Payroll
Test Data: 1. Select Draft Payroll 2. Click 'Recalculate'
Date of execution: System clears current calculations and pulls fresh attendance/leave data.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can Mark Payroll as Paid
Test Data: 1. Select Approved Payroll 2. Click 'Mark as Paid' 3. Enter Transaction ID
Date of execution: Status changes to 'Paid' and Payslip becomes visible to employee.

Test Steps: Verify Employee is notified when Salary is disbursed
Test Data: 1. Mark Payroll as Paid 2. Check Employee notifications/email
Date of execution: Employee receives notification: 'Your salary for <Month> has been processed'.

Test Steps: Verify Employee can view their own Payslip
Test Data: 1. Log in as Employee 2. Go to Salary/Payslips 3. Open latest Payslip
Date of execution: Payslip loads correctly showing all company details and salary breakdown.

Test Steps: Verify Employee can download Payslip as PDF
Test Data: 1. Open Payslip 2. Click 'Download PDF'
Date of execution: PDF downloads correctly with proper formatting, tables, and company logo.

Test Steps: Verify Payslip contains accurate LWP and Working Days count
Test Data: 1. Check Payslip Header/Summary section
Date of execution: 'Total Days', 'Days Worked', and 'LWP' fields should match attendance data.

Test Steps: Verify Payslip accurately spells out Net Pay in words
Test Data: 1. Check 'Amount in words' section on Payslip
Date of execution: Text should read 'Fifty Thousand Five Hundred Only'.

Test Steps: Verify FnF calculation for resigning employee
Test Data: 1. Go to Terminations/Resignations 2. Select Employee 3. Run Full and Final Settlement
Date of execution: System calculates pending salary for partial month worked.

Test Steps: Verify Leave Encashment is added to FnF
Test Data: 1. Ensure resigning employee has 10 Earned Leaves 2. Run FnF
Date of execution: System calculates monetary value of 10 days and adds to Gross Settlement.

Test Steps: Verify Notice Period Recovery is deducted in FnF
Test Data: 1. Employee leaves 15 days before notice period ends 2. Run FnF
Date of execution: System calculates penalty for 15 days and deducts from Final Settlement.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can grant Salary Advance/Loan
Test Data: 1. Go to Salary Advances 2. Grant 10000 to Employee 3. Set EMI as 2000/month
Date of execution: Advance is recorded and scheduled for deduction.

Test Steps: Verify EMI is automatically deducted during Payroll
Test Data: 1. Run Payroll for month having EMI due 2. Check Deductions
Date of execution: Payslip shows 'Loan EMI' deduction of 2000.

Test Steps: Verify Employee cannot view Payslip of another Employee
Test Data: 1. Log in as Employee A 2. Change URL ID to Employee B's Payslip ID
Date of execution: System should return '403 Forbidden' or 'Unauthorized Access' error.

Test Steps: Verify Non-Admin cannot access Payroll Processing module
Test Data: 1. Log in as Staff/Manager 2. Try to access /hrms/payroll URL
Date of execution: System redirects to dashboard with 'Access Denied' message.
